One firm for the whole building story.

Arc of Abuja Limited is an architectural design and construction company based in Abuja. We draw the plans, pour the foundations, craft the woodwork and style the interiors, so one accountable team carries your project from concept to keys.

Every wall, ceiling line and joint is measured twice. That is what we mean by creativity with precision.

Registered company, RC 1856166

What we do

◭

Architecture

Residential and commercial design, from villas to shopping malls, with facades that catch light at night.

▦

Construction

Structural frameworks, slabs, staircases and full builds, supervised on site by our own engineers.

◈

Exquisite Interiors

Living rooms, bedrooms and double-height spaces with layered lighting, stone and soft textiles.

▤

Premium Woodwork

Walk-in closets, TV consoles, kitchens and fluted wall panels, made to measure.

⌂

Real Estate

Well-located homes and developments, designed and finished to our own standard.

✦

Full Remodelling

All-inclusive house remodelling, like Project Lumiere in Games Village, Abuja.
